home.title: Knowledge for
home.description: A carefully curated library of free courses, lawful books, and open-source software — built for learners in Bangladesh, India, and Pakistan.
home.searchPlaceholder: What do you want to learn today?
home.trust: No cracked software. No pirated PDFs. No paywalls pretending to be free.
home.featuredSubtitle: Resources we have checked for free access, lawful distribution, and real learning value.
home.categoriesSubtitle: From school fundamentals to professional skills — start with the subject that pulls you in.
home.regionalSubtitle: We prioritise resources that work on modest devices and data plans, and highlight government and regional programmes.
home.bangladeshText: NCTB textbooks, Bangla-accessible courses, and free digital-skills pathways.
home.indiaText: NCERT, NPTEL, SWAYAM, and open university resources from across India.
home.pakistanText: DigiSkills, Urdu-friendly learning, and globally open curricula.
home.legalDescription: Every listing is reviewed against a simple standard: the creator must allow free access, and the official source must be clear.
home.legalPoint1Text: Only free-to-access courses, public-domain works, open-licensed books, or author-permitted PDFs.
home.legalPoint2Text: Only free and open-source software, always linked to the official download page.
home.legalPoint3Text: We never host executables or copyrighted files. We point you to the source that owns them.
home.legalPoint4Text: Every resource has a report button. Copyright concerns are reviewed and actioned.
home.ctaTitle: Know a resource we should add?
home.ctaText: Help another learner discover something legal, free, and genuinely useful. Community submissions are reviewed before publishing.
home.alternativesSubtitle: Same job, no licence fee. Every alternative below is open source and links straight to the official download.

about.title: A fairer starting line for learning.
about.subtitle: Talent is everywhere. Access isn't. We make the legal, free learning web easier to find for learners in Bangladesh, India, and Pakistan.
about.missionP1: OpenLearn Hub is a curated discovery layer for free education. We do not create courses or host files; we find resources that are already free and legal, then make them easier to search, understand, and trust.
about.missionP2: Every listing is checked for free access, clear licensing, and an official source. When something changes, anyone can report it and our moderators will investigate.
about.standard1Text: A resource must be usable without payment. Optional paid certificates are allowed only when the learning itself is free.
about.standard2Text: Books must be public domain, openly licensed, or explicitly shared by the author or publisher. No pirated copies, no file mirrors.
about.standard3Text: Software listings always link to the publisher's official download page. We never host executables or repackage installers.
about.standard4Text: We favour resources that work on low-bandwidth connections and modest devices, with regional languages where available.
about.regionalText: Bangladesh, India, and Pakistan share enormous talent and unequal access. We highlight government programmes, regional language material, and curriculum resources that learners here actually need.
about.contactText: If a link is wrong, a licence is unclear, or you know a resource we should add, we want to hear from you.
about.aiText: LearnMate is designed to recommend from our vetted library and explain its reasoning. It is an assistant, not a replacement for a teacher or official curriculum.
